description: Codex CLI app-logs sub-pipeline — invoked by the logs-apm.app@custom router only for service.name=codex_cli_rs, so no service.name guard is needed here. (1) Drops the three verified high-volume, content-free streaming-delta events (response.output_text.delta, response.function_call_arguments.delta, response.custom_tool_call_input.delta) — together ~91% of the event/log_only stream; the complete value lands on the terminal .done event. Explicit allowlist, NOT endsWith('.delta'): a wildcard would blindly drop unverified/future .delta kinds (refusal, reasoning-summary, …) — a new kind joins only once its reconstructability is verified. (2) Redacts raw tool I/O (labels.arguments / labels.output) on the codex.tool_result log_only twin and the user-prompt text (labels.prompt) on the codex.user_prompt log_only twin to [REDACTED] at ingest, so sensitive content never persists in ES; the trace_safe metadata twins are untouched. See SPEC/codex-cli-telemetry.md.
